251361|d8b5b5c2.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
251361|d8b5b5c2.text: What do you need of me, child of Zephras?

251371|c4bcd3c9.name: Falorne Fallwind
251371|c4bcd3c9.text: Greetings to you, fellow High Order initiate.

251373|dcc47b5a.name: Xyton Silverwind
251373|dcc47b5a.text: If you have the aptitude for the $cic arts, I can train you.

251376|fb6560cd.name: Tai'ree Farsight
251376|fb6560cd.text:
The hunters and rangers of Zephras have never been more needed. The winds grow ever harsher, and the magic that sustains our island is fading. The wilds have never been more wild and people like me are needed to keep our people safe.

If you have the proper aptitude as a hunter, I can give you the tools to survive the wilds.

251487|06790c88.name: Ventaari Brightwish
251487|06790c88.text:
Zephras is in a state of decline, unfortunately. The elemental wind spirits that brought us here to Skywall so many thousands of years ago have vanished, causing us to lose much of the magic on which we've depended for millennia.

The island itself is also dangerously unstable, and we've even lost contact with the other island provinces of the shen'dorei. The few Windshapers that still possess the gift of skysight have attempted to contact our brothers and sisters on the other islands, but we have had no response.

Many among us are worried that the shen'dorei here on Zephras are all that is left of our people.

251487|4a2bfdee.name: Ventaari Brightwish
251487|4a2bfdee.text:
I can tell by your aura that you are of Highborne lineage, yes? Those that call themselves members of the High Order find very little common ground with the members of my order, the Windshapers. Outside the relative harmony of Thendal Grove, you may find that these divisions run very deep, deep enough to drive division and even violence.

Be mindful of this as you move throughout Zephras Isle. I'll offer you this one warning... do not cross the Windshapers.

251487|ba1aa782.name: Ventaari Brightwish
251487|ba1aa782.text:
The shen'dorei will always owe the spirits a debt for their aid, and the Windshapers have sworn an oath to repay that debt and restore things to the way they were before. Unfortunately, we are dangerously blind to what is happening around us within Skywall without the spirits to guide us.

The High Order are shortsighted and arrogant, just like their Highborne ancestors. They seek to master and control the magic of this place. This is very path that led us to flee from Kalimdor and reside here in the first place. I fear that much like our forebears their confidence has vastly outpaced their competence and the end result could be disastrous.

251523|14e578ce.name: Constable Aonda
251523|14e578ce.text: <Constable Aonda wears an intense look on her face, clearly deep in thought.>

251903|777ae0ec.name: Rathiril Sunlance
251903|777ae0ec.text:
Hello there, young $c. I am Rathiril Sunlance and I am an elder Magister of the High Order here on Zephras Isle. It's always good to see bright-eyed young shen'dorei, ready to do their duty in service to their homeland.

Don't let this dusty old mage hold you up however, no doubt you've got many adventures to see to. Feel free to stop by later if you'd like to speak more.

251904|7a98291a.name: Sania Silverstream
251904|7a98291a.text:
Hello, friend. I am Sania Silverstream and I am a missionary in service of our almighty master, Al'Akir the Windlord. 

The Al'Aketh are derisively referred to as a violent "cult" but in reality, we are seekers of peace and enlightenment. Our lord Al'Akir is the supreme force here in the realm of Skywall, and only through his grace are we to survive the trials our people currently face.

If you wish to hear more of the good news, please call upon me anytime and we will speak further. Blessings of the Windlord upon you, friend.

251905|3541aa81.name: Zerril Softbreeze
251905|3541aa81.text: If you need training as a cook, I have a few tips and tricks I could pass on! Ho ho! Throw on an apron and let's get started!

251905|48ad85dc.name: Zerril Softbreeze
251905|48ad85dc.text: Ho there, traveler! New to town? Well, once you get settled in come see me if you'd like some work. I've been working overtime preparing for the Festival of Winds and I'll take all the help I can get keeping the larders full!

251906|e9380575.name: Teeri Wellwind
251906|e9380575.text:
Unless you are here on business pertaining to V.L.O., I'm afraid I won't have a lot of time for chatter. If you want to pitch in and help out around town, I'll certainly put you to work though.

Oh, what does V.L.O. stand for? Village Live Operations, of course. Even frontier towns like these don't manage themselves. Between major incidents, unplanned wind power outages, and bug infestations, keeping this place moving forward is no joke.

251913|70e7404c.name: Aedi Thriceforged
251913|70e7404c.text: I can teach you to swing a blacksmith's hammer, if you are willing to learn.

251991|8173c391.name: Taleen Shimmerthread
251991|8173c391.text:
The clothcraft of the Shen'dorei is a harmonious imitation of the flowing, carefree currents of the winds. While the spirits have left us, and I know not when I may see them dance once more... I find great comfort in my art, if only as a distraction.

I can teach you to work the cloth as well, if you'd like to learn?

251993|453a25ae.name: Indari Sunseam
251993|453a25ae.text: I can teach you to craft fine leather armor, if you have the aptitude.

254081|dcc47b5a.name: Naeluna Swiftmend
254081|dcc47b5a.text: If you have the aptitude for the $cic arts, I can train you.

254084|fb6560cd.name: Elayaa Easewind
254084|fb6560cd.text:
The hunters and rangers of Zephras have never been more needed. The winds grow ever harsher, and the magic that sustains our island is fading. The wilds have never been more wild and people like me are needed to keep our people safe.

If you have the proper aptitude as a hunter, I can give you the tools to survive the wilds.

254089|9cc50b7d.name: Coriella Calmbreeze
254089|9cc50b7d.text: Welcome to the Calmbreeze Inn, traveler. Would you like some refreshment?

254100|184ef800.name: Zephras Citizen
254100|184ef800.text:
Have you heard of what's become of Ban'aethal? The peacekeepers are warning people to stay away from the ruins and the Shadowgale Forest entirely.

I overheard someone at the inn talking about seeing malevolent wind spirits that seemed to be little more than a hazy outline, as if they were... hollowed out somehow.

Gives me the chills just thinking about such a thing.

254100|1ab538e5.name: Zephras Citizen
254100|1ab538e5.text:
The Al'Aketh cult is becoming a major problem and the peacekeepers seem powerless to stop them. We can only hope that the Windshapers and the High Order can put aside their bickering and work with the peacekeepers to protect us.

I certainly don't want to join a cult!

254100|609c70df.name: Zephras Citizen
254100|609c70df.text: The Windshapers and the High Order are up to something. There are rumors floating around that both groups plan to get the skycutters running again and use them to leave the Skywall. LEAVE SKYWALL? How ridiculous. Where would they even go?

257018|c65683ed.name: Naleeia Tattermend
257018|c65683ed.text: Winds tidings. What can I help you with?

257019|d62b45b0.name: Nyassa Swiftdraught
257019|d62b45b0.text: Gales greetings, friend. Is there something I can help you with?

257024|ec1a6e0b.name: Mendalass Tattermend
257024|ec1a6e0b.text: I don't get too many Skinners in here looking for training, but I guess I could teach you something if you're ready.

2980|e775a01e.name: Grull Hawkwind
2980|e775a01e.text: Greetings, $N, and welcome to Camp Narache. News of your arrival spread quickly among the tribe.

363-accept.name: Undertaker Mordo
363-accept.text:
About time you woke up. We were ready to toss you into the fire with the others, but it looks like you made it.

I am Mordo, the caretaker of the crypt of Deathknell. And you are the Lich King's slave no more.

Speak with Shadow Priest Sarvis in the chapel at the base of the hill, he will tell you more of what you must know.
363-accept.title: Rude Awakening

4641-accept.name: Kaltunk
4641-accept.text:
Finally, you are of age, $N... of age to battle in the name of the Horde. To conquer for the glory of the Warchief.

Yes...

<Kaltunk looks you over.>

You will do nicely.

No doubt you wish to find a great dragon or demon and strangle it with your bare hands, but perhaps it would be wise to start on something less... dangerous.

<Kaltunk laughs.>

Report to Gornek, he should be able to assign a task better suited to a young $c. You will find Gornek in the Den, to the west.
4641-accept.title: Your Place in the World

747-accept.name: Grull Hawkwind
747-accept.text:
You have a promising air about you, and will prove yourself to the tribe. Perhaps someday soon you will be welcomed into the great city of Thunder Bluff. But before that can happen you must prove yourself to my father, Chief Hawkwind.

Up here on Red Cloud Mesa we pride ourselves on keen hunting skills. $R hunt out of necessity and for sport. Our supply of meats has run low and we require feathers for clothing. Hunt the nearby plainstriders and prove yourself by resupplying the village.
747-accept.title: The Hunt Begins

752-accept.name: Chief Hawkwind
752-accept.text:
All members of the tribe share in the harmony of life. We live together and work together.

Our commitment to one another carries with it a high degree of responsibility. I ask of you now a humble task.

My mother set out this morning to fetch water from the well to the southeast of Narache. It has been quite some time now. Perhaps you could check on her for me while I attend to tribal matters here?
752-accept.title: A Humble Task

92463-complete.name: Elatrell Featherlight
92463-complete.text: Excellent work, $N. You'd make a fine ranger if this whole "adventurer" thing doesn't work out for you.
92463-complete.title: The Cirrusfly Queen

92469-complete.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92469-complete.text:
This is most troubling, but unfortunately unsurprising. We've been aware of the cult's movements for some time, but we've been content to watch from afar. Their agitation of the wind spirits near the standing stones is a clear escalation on their part.

You've performed a difficult but necessary service for Thendal Grove, $N. Thank you.
92469-complete.title: Return to Rorian

92470-accept.name: Aetheen of the Gales
92470-accept.text:
Rorian informed you that I've been watching you. I now offer you a test of resolve. However, be warned--it will send you into great danger.

Go to the caves to the south. Thin out the ursera's numbers there, and find their matriarch, one the rangers call "Urs'anah". Put her down and bring me proof of her demise. Once you have done that, you will have taken an important step on your path.
92470-accept.title: Foul Matriarch

92470-complete.name: Aetheen of the Gales
92470-complete.text: Very well done. You've felled beasts and laid low cultist interlopers. You have shown great promise but your path must soon take you beyond the relative safety of Thendal Village.
92470-complete.title: Foul Matriarch

92470-progress.name: Aetheen of the Gales
92470-progress.text: What I ask of you is not easy, but you must be prepared for much greater challenges if you are to survive long enough to be of service to Zephras Isle.
92470-progress.title: Foul Matriarch

92471-accept.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92471-accept.text:
You may not realize this but everything you've done has been a trial of sorts. A test for what is to come for you. It's a big island out there, and Zephras needs spirited young adventurers such as yourself if we are to survive the trials our people face.

The one called Aetheen of the Gales is one of the leaders of our people here on Zephras Isle, and she has been watching you. She has a task that you must complete. Speak with her to learn more.
92471-accept.title: Aetheen of the Gales

92471-complete.name: Aetheen of the Gales
92471-complete.text:
Rorian has told me much of you. I am likely unknown to you, but I am a member of the Council of Elders here on Zephras Isle. I've come to read the flow of the winds here in Thendal Grove. I'm also here to assess young shen'dorei such as yourself that are coming of age.

So tell me, are you ready to take your next step? Are you ready to serve Zephras Isle?
92471-complete.title: Aetheen of the Gales

92472-accept.name: Aetheen of the Gales
92472-accept.text:
One of the most pervasive threats on Zephras Isle is the Al'Aketh Cult. They are religious zealots devoted to the worship of the supposed elemental ruler of Skywall, Al'Akir the Windlord. They are brutal, single minded, and their power and ambitions are growing more deadly by the day.

Your path will soon take you to Shen'dar Village to the south. Present yourself to Constable Aonda when you arrive. The cult threatens Shen'dar and they are in need of aid. Tell Aonda that I sent you.
92472-accept.title: The Next Step

92472-complete.name: Constable Aonda
92472-complete.text: Aetheen sent you, then? I'll confess, you don't look like much to me, but Shen'dar Village won't turn down willing aid, much less aid sent from Elder Aetheen herself.
92472-complete.title: The Next Step

92473-accept.name: Valreaa Valewind
92473-accept.text:
The ursera den to the southwest is rapidly becoming a problem. Just last week the rangers had to kill an adolescent ursera who wandered too close to the village and attempted to attack a boy playing near the base of the elder tree in the center of the village.

We were fortunate that the boy escaped with his life. Hunger and desperation makes these beasts too dangerous to be left unchecked. Go south and put the scrawniest among the ursera down. Bring me their claws as proof when it is done.
92473-accept.title: Aggressive Encroachment

92473-complete.name: Valreaa Valewind
92473-complete.text: Well done, $c. The Rangers of the Grove are in your debt.
92473-complete.title: Aggressive Encroachment

92473-progress.name: Valreaa Valewind
92473-progress.text: The ursera have grown far more aggressive of late. I wonder what has changed to cause this shift in behavior?
92473-progress.title: Aggressive Encroachment

92515-accept.name: Indari Sunseam
92515-accept.text:
As if bandits and mad cultists weren't enough, the hills are thick with prideclaws as well right now. They are starting to encroach on the village borders and growing bolder by the day. It's only a matter of time before someone's pet or child is taken. It would be a mercy for us to cull their numbers now rather than after some tragedy occurs.

Bring me a dozen or so of their pelts. I can turn them into all sorts of goods that will be of aid to the village.
92515-accept.title: The Problem With Prideclaws

92516-accept.name: Teeri Wellwind
92516-accept.text: A flock of Hippogryph have recently established nesting grounds southeast of Shen'dar Village and they've been wreaking havoc on travelers on the road. I need someone to head down there and thin them out for us.
92516-accept.title: Hippogryph Harrassment

92517-accept.name: Constable Aonda
92517-accept.text:
There's a cave not far to the north, hidden behind a waterfall. It's well known to me that there's a group of bandits that are operating out of that cave. They were a problem for us before the cult arrived, but now they are a real terror. I can't spare the people to go and clear them out, unfortunately.

I need you to go there and take care of them for me. Kill as many as you can, and if possible, take out their leader, the one they call "Badwind" Bennic. That cave is dangerous, so be careful.
92517-accept.title: The Criminal Element

92544-accept.name: Hanaa Nightwind
92544-accept.text:
A band of Al'Aketh cult ruffians have taken up residence near the temple ruins just southwest of here, led by a real monster called Malduko Cloudcrush. This rabble has no doubt been dispatched here by High Priestess Lorthuna at the Shrine of Akir to attack travelers and coerce our people into joining the cult.

I need to stay here at my post to alert travelers leaving the grove of the danger, but I would be grateful if you could do something about those cultists and their leader for me.
92544-accept.title: Al'Aketh Thugs

92544-complete.name: Hanaa Nightwind
92544-complete.text:
It was all I could do to stop myself from going over and joining you from my position here. I can only hope that these louts got the message and clear out of here soon. 

Thank you, $c. You have the gratitude of the Rangers of Thendal Grove.
92544-complete.title: Al'Aketh Thugs

92553-accept.name: Zerril Softbreeze
92553-accept.text:
Up for a bit of work? I could use a bit of muscle from a strong adventuring-type such as yourself. With how dangerous things are getting around here, no one's had much time to hunt or forage of late, and I need someone to get out there and source me fresh eggs and strider meat to keep this village fed.

I'd be happy to teach you one of my famous recipes if you can bring me what I need. What do you say?
92553-accept.title: Restocking the Larders

92596-accept.name: Rathiril Sunlance
92596-accept.text:
The aura of arcane energy that surrounds you is strong, even though you are not initiated as a mage. I am quite sure that you are going to be a capable adventurer, and your connection with our ancient magic will only ever be a boon to you even if you were to never utter a single word of power in spellcasting.

Come, let us sit and speak some on my order, the nature of the arcane here on Zephras, and the plight of our people.
92596-accept.title: The High Order

92596-complete.name: Rathiril Sunlance
92596-complete.text:
The High Order's mission is vital to the survival of our people. We hold our elemental benefactors in the utmost regard, but we must face reality; they are gone now, and we are on our own.

Between threats from within such as the Al'Aketh, and uncertainties of our security on this plane, it is our destiny as Highborne descendants of our ancestral home of Eldre'Thalas to use our gifts to ensure that the shen'dorei can stand on our own once again.
92596-complete.title: The High Order

92597-complete.name: Falorne Fallwind
92597-complete.text:
Do you feel it? Yes? Good! You have taken your first steps. You'll find that with your abilities, you will be able to tap into latent magical energy in many locations. Doing so will provide a myriad of benefits, some profound, others more subtle. You won't know until you tap into them, But that's the best part of the gift... making the unknown known.

If we are to survive these dire times, we must be unwavering in our search for knowledge... and power.
92597-complete.title: Reading the Ley Lines

93318-accept.name: Unknown
93318-accept.text:
By order of Constable Aonda of the Peacekeepers, a bounty is hereby placed upon the scourge of the highlands, Vulgara the Insatiable. Last spotted on a hilltop rise just southwest of Shen'dar Village, the winged vuldren terror is highly dangerous and should be approached with caution.

Deliver the beast's head to Danarii Bellowveil to receive your reward.
93318-accept.title: WANTED: Vulgara the Insatiable

93319-accept.name: Teeri Wellwind
93319-accept.text:
We are relying on windstones more and more for day to day living here on Zephras so we try and maintain a cache of them in reserve for emergencies. Lately I've noticed some go missing from our stores.

We've found windstones on bandits we've captured recently, and I suspect they are behind our shortages.

If you find yourself near the bandit cave to the north, mind knocking a few heads together and reclaiming some of our pilfered windstones for me?
93319-accept.title: Pilfered Windstones

93461-accept.name: Constable Aonda
93461-accept.text:
You've got that "High Order" look to you. Those with Highborne ancestry always seem to have a slight twinkle in their eyes that gives it away. Before I properly put you to work around here, you should check in with our resident High Order elder Rathiril Sunlance. You can find him here in the main lodge, just around the corner from me.

Oh, and check in with Coriella Calmbreeze as well, she runs the local inn and can provide lodging and supplies, should you need them.
93461-accept.title: Welcome to Shen'dar Village

93461-complete.name: Constable Aonda
93461-complete.text:
Checked in with Rathiril then? Great. Lots of tension between the High Order and the Windshapers these days, but they keep things civil here in Shen'dar. Well, at least in the village anyway. What happens out in the wilds stays in the wilds.

Now that that's done, you look like someone who might be looking for something to do with their hands. I've got a few things that need doing, if you are game for a bit of work?
93461-complete.title: Welcome to Shen'dar Village

93552-complete.name: Dalia the Collector
93552-complete.text:
Thank you very much for these. As elves we all have a deep connection to magic and these windstones are becoming more and more precious as the magic imbued into this island by the great anchor pylons continues to fade. 

Windstones aren't the only beneficial thing you can harvest from the land. Please, take one of these manuals.
93552-complete.title: Harvesting Windstones

93951-accept.name: Taleen Shimmerthread
93951-accept.text:
The Hippogryph that have taken up residence southwest of the village can be a nuisance, but they also present a rather unique opportunity to obtain their feathers. Many $r love to adorn their hair with vibrant plumes and the down feathers of a hippogryph are exceptionally vibrant and more importantly, silky soft.

If you are heading that way, try and gather as many of the fallen feathers as you can from in and around their nesting grounds. Do be careful, as wild hippogryph are not tolerant of guests.
93951-accept.title: A Little Beauty

94413-accept.name: Rathiril Sunlance
94413-accept.text:
The recent emergence of the ley lines on the surface of Zephras has been profound for our order. We have more direct and tangible access to the energies that permeate this place and it has increased our understanding of said magic greatly.

The Windshapers, however, view these emergences as scars on the land that must be "healed". This is an affront to our order and is something we simply cannot abide.

Go to the ley line in the forest to the southwest and drive off the Windshapers you find there.
94413-accept.title: A Magical Affront

96101-accept.name: Raan Wildwind
96101-accept.text:
Greetings, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96101-accept.title: The Great Outdoors

96101-complete.name: Raan Wildwind
96101-complete.text: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.
96101-complete.title: The Great Outdoors

96638-accept.name: Aetheen of the Gales
96638-accept.text:
More and more adventurers like yourself have been seeking glory and fortune outside of the safety of Thendal Grove. There's one such adventurer who has made a camp outside of Shen'dar Village, along the road leading southwest out of Thendal Grove.

Seek him out and see what you can learn from him that may help you in your own travels.
96638-accept.title: The Adventurer

96646-accept.name: Raan Wildwind
96646-accept.text:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.
96646-accept.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96646-complete.name: Zerril Softbreeze
96646-complete.text:
With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.

Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.

You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.
96646-complete.title: Camping 101: Cooking

97965-accept.name: Raan Wildwind
97965-accept.text:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $c.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.
97965-accept.title: Camping 101: First Aid

97971-accept.name: Raan Wildwind
97971-accept.text:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.
97971-accept.title: Camping 101: Skinning

97971-complete.name: Mendalass Tattermend
97971-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Camp Chair. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97971-complete.title: Camping 101: Skinning
